input: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has fundamentally transformed the contemporary technological landscape and redefined the manner in which individuals interact with digital systems. Artificial intelligence refers to the capability of machines and computational frameworks to simulate cognitive processes traditionally associated with human intelligence. These processes include learning, reasoning, decision-making, language comprehension, and problem-solving. In recent years, AI technologies have become increasingly integrated into diverse sectors such as healthcare, finance, education, transportation, and scientific research.
